note: First Iraqi Bank's fees and charges for 2026: its current and savings accounts cost nothing to open, keep or close; it charges for reactivating a dormant account and for certified statements, which the game doesn't count.

sources.title: First Iraqi Bank, Fees and Charges of First Iraqi Bank for 2026
sources.said: Fees and Charges of First Iraqi Bank for 2026 ... Current and Savings Accounts ... Commission for opening an account ... Free ... Commission for account Closing ... Free ... Commission for reactivating a dormant account ... 10,000
